採用・広告の製品.quote: Providing on-site expertise where and when the work demands it.
Our mixed reality platform connects frontline workers real-time with the expertise, technical information, and operational knowledge.

Kognitiv Spark was built around a simple belief: the people performing critical work should never be limited by when or where they can access the support they need. We make expertise available where work happens, reducing operational friction while improving collaboration, execution, and knowledge transfer across the workforce.
Work doesn't pause when uncertainty, pressure, or unexpected issues arise. Yet every day, frontline workers face unfamiliar problems without immediate access to the support they need to move forward.

Organizations invest heavily in skilled people, established processes, and operational knowledge. But when work begins, expertise and technical information aren't always available where they're needed most, creating unnecessary delays, disrupting execution, and making valuable operational knowledge harder to preserve over time.
THE REALITY OF FRONTLINE WORK

By connecting workers with experts, delivering information at the point of work, and preserving knowledge as work is completed, RemoteSpark helps organizations remove barriers to execution and improve the way critical work gets done.
Enable real-time collaboration with remote specialists who can see and hear what the worker is doing, provide visual guidance, and help resolve issues without waiting for travel or site access.

Provide procedures, manuals, images, recorded step-by-step instructions, and visual work instructions directly at the point of work, giving workers the information they need without lifting their head.
Preserve knowledge through real work.
Capture observations, images, videos, and support sessions as work happens, creating a growing library of operational knowledge that supports inspections, audits, and future workers.
Where innovation meets frontline work.

We believe technology is at its best when it enhances human capability and helps people accomplish more than they could on their own. Every decision we make is guided by the realities of frontline work, ensuring our solution is practical to adopt, intuitive to use, and designed to deliver lasting operational value.

Every organization faces different challenges, workflows, and operational goals. Whether you're exploring connected worker technology for the first time or looking to expand an existing program, we'll start by understanding your environment before recommending an approach.
Talk with our team about your use cases, operational challenges, frontline limitations, and where our mixed reality platform can create the greatest impact.
Keep production moving with expertise where it's needed.

When production depends on quick decisions and reliable execution, our mixed reality platform connects frontline workers with experts and operational knowledge to reduce downtime and keep production lines moving.
Supporting the work that keeps production running.

Support planned and reactive maintenance with immediate access to expert guidance, procedures, and technical documentation to maximize maintenance windows, reduce downtime, and improve first-time resolution.
Production Troubleshooting

Whether responding to a line stoppage, supporting a changeover, or troubleshooting unexpected equipment issues, frontline teams get access to operational knowledge and expert guidance at the point of need to minimize disruptions.

Support equipment installation, testing, and commissioning with real-time access to remote OEM specialists, helping teams resolve issues early, accelerate production readiness, and meet production quality standards.

We believe the people performing critical work should always have access to the expertise, information, and support they need to solve problems and make confident decisions. This belief drives everything we do, from the technology we build to the partnerships we create.

Kognitiv Spark is a global technology company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Fredericton, New Brunswick, with offices in the United Kingdom and the United States. We exist to help organizations ensure frontline workers have access to the expertise, information, and support they need when critical work is underway.

Our flagship platform, RemoteSpark™, brings remote experts, operational knowledge, and frontline teams together through secure mixed reality collaboration. Workers can connect with specialists, access technical information, and receive guidance directly at the point of work helping organizations solve problems faster, reduce operational delays, and preserve valuable knowledge.

Every organization faces different challenges, workflows, and operational goals. Whether you're exploring connected worker technology for the first time or looking to expand an existing program, we'll start by understanding your environment before recommending an approach.
Talk with our team about your use cases, operational challenges, frontline limitations, and where our mixed reality platform can create the greatest impact.

Kognitiv Spark is at the forefront of developing immersive enterprise software that empowers connected workers. Driven by a desire to exceed expectations, we are a team of dedicated, highly skilled professionals who make everything we do possible. We believe in human potential and that, with the power of technology, ordinary people can achieve extraordinary things.

Kognitiv Spark works with technology providers, system integrators, and industry partners to deliver secure, practical solutions that help frontline teams access expertise, operational knowledge, and support where work happens.

At Kognitiv Spark, we believe that strong partnerships are essential to delivering critical technology to those who need it most. Whether you’re integrating our platform, teaming on strategic pursuits, or simply referring great leads, there’s a place for you in our ecosystem.

The RemoteSpark tool is tailored for industrial use. It enhances performance by allowing users to work in their physical space while accessing digital content to facilitate task completion, boost operational efficiency, and aid workers with on-the-job training.

For industries like manufacturing, construction, energy, defence, and aerospace, RemoteSpark is a powerful tool for training and up-skilling workers, boosting the productivity of companies that use the technology in day-to-day operations.
has partnered with Japanese technology company HMS Inc. to integrate HMS’s SiNGRAY G2 augmented reality glasses with Kognitiv Spark’s RemoteSpark platform for remote support of industrial workers.

Announced Oct. 1, the partnership will combine the hardware with software that allows technicians working on infrastructure, military equipment and industrial machinery to receive guidance from remote experts.

HMS designed the G2 for industrial environments, with IP65-rated protection against dust and water and Micro-OLED displays intended for use in bright conditions. The company said the headset has also undergone safety testing, including drop-ball and impact tests.

Kognitiv Spark develops augmented and mixed reality software for field workers who need access to specialized expertise while working in remote or demanding environments. Its customers include organizations in defence, energy and manufacturing.
HMS president and CEO Zhencheng Hu said the integration would pair his company’s industrial hardware with Kognitiv Spark’s remote-support software.

HMS, headquartered in Fukuoka, Japan, specializes in AI-driven image processing, visual simultaneous localization and mapping (VSLAM), and edge computing. The company said it has shipped more than 32,000 3D sensing devices to industrial customers in Japan.

With the SiNGRAY G2, remote workers in the Defence, Energy and Manufacturing sectors can call an expert through RemoteSpark, and the expert sees what the technician sees. The expert can talk them through the job, mark up the equipment in front of them, and send over 3D models, manuals and schematics. The technician keeps both hands on the work.

“We’ve never been about the headset for its own sake. We’re about the person wearing it,” said Yan Simard, CEO of Kognitiv Spark. “Our customers do hard, critical work. They keep ships ready, energy flowing and production lines running. The G2 is built for the places our users actually work, and it lets us keep putting the expertise right in their hands.”
IP65 sealing and bright Micro-OLED displays take mixed reality off the clean-room floor and onto decks, rigs and plant floors.

“HMS builds hardware for people who can’t afford for it to quit halfway through a job,” said Dr. Zhencheng Hu, President and CEO of HMS Inc. “Kognitiv Spark has spent years earning the trust of Defence departments, utilities and manufacturers. Pairing the G2 with RemoteSpark means that trust now comes with glasses built to match it.”
